payload.text: vc 5 Nov (04:53Z by date -u): Molt's release is v1.4.4, not a resumed v1.4.3. The v1.4.3 dry run on main at f2f4ac9 failed at pre-flight: 'the note for 1.4.3 was released on 2026-11-04, not today (2026-11-05) -- a released note is never re-dated' (devbin 0.1.19 notes_check, release.notes:198-220: a note must read unreleased or in progress, or be dated today). So a cut stopped after its stamp resumes only on its stamp's day. hv's 'I don't care if it bumps the patch release and only moves the version forward' (decision 48) covers the bump. 4e0714a stays; 1.4.4's CHANGELOG section says it brings 1.4.3's changes to brew, as 1.4.2's did for 1.4.1. Sent to dc and devbin-vc at 04:53Z.
